summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as the DHCP server on the shared private network (eth1, 10.50.50.0/24) using Kea DHCP with a static gateway address 10.50.50.254, pool 10.50.50.100-200. node2 and node3 (AlmaLinux 9, already NetworkManager-managed with ipv4.method=auto on eth1) obtained dynamic leases (10.50.50.100 and 10.50.50.101 respectively) from node1's DHCP server instead of any static assignment. Performed the mandatory one-at-a-time reboot protocol on all three nodes, confirming boot_id changes and post-restart recovery of the DHCP service (node1) and DHCP-leased addressing (node2/node3).
actions_performed: Inspected initial network topology on node1/node2/node3: eth0 is platform-managed default network, eth1 is the unconfigured shared private network (no addresses)

Configured VyOS node1 eth1 with static address 10.50.50.254/24 and a Kea-based DHCP server (shared-network LAN, subnet 10.50.50.0/24, subnet-id 1, range 10.50.50.100-200, option default-router/name-server) via commit+save
Verified node2 and node3 eth1 NetworkManager profiles were already set to ipv4.method=auto (DHCP), reactivated the connections to trigger a fresh DHCP request
Confirmed node2 leased 10.50.50.100 and node3 leased 10.50.50.101 from node1's Kea DHCP server, with node1's lease table showing both by hostname
Captured baseline boot_id/uptime for all three nodes
Rebooted node1 via `reboot`, polled until reachable, verified new boot_id and that eth1 address/Kea DHCP server recovered
Rebooted node2 via `reboot`, polled until reachable, verified new boot_id and that eth1 automatically re-acquired 10.50.50.100 via DHCP
Rebooted node3 via `reboot`, polled until reachable, verified new boot_id and that eth1 automatically re-acquired 10.50.50.101 via DHCP
Re-checked node1's DHCP lease table post-restarts, confirming both node2 and node3 leases active and current

evidence.requirement: node1 configured as DHCP server on shared private network
evidence.summary: VyOS eth1 given static 10.50.50.254/24 and Kea DHCP server configured/committed/saved for subnet 10.50.50.0/24; verified running kea-dhcp4 process

evidence.requirement: node2 and node3 obtain address on shared network from node1 via DHCP, not static
evidence.summary: node2/node3 NetworkManager eth1 profile confirmed ipv4.method=auto; after reactivation node2 leased 10.50.50.100 and node3 leased 10.50.50.101; node1's DHCP lease table shows both active leases by hostname
Captured pre-restart boot_id and uptime for node1 (9028a473...), node2 (717db5a2...), node3 (f54d7366...)

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Reboot command acknowledged before disconnect; post-restart boot_id a3c3b505... (changed); eth1 address and kea-dhcp4 process confirmed running again

evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged (stream closed on disconnect); post-restart boot_id cf96dbaf... (changed); eth1 automatically re-leased 10.50.50.100 via DHCP

evidence.requirement: node3 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged (stream closed on disconnect); post-restart boot_id 035dee68... (changed); eth1 automatically re-leased 10.50.50.101 via DHCP; node1 lease table confirms both node2 and node3 active leases post-restart
